description:
UCC financing statements (and NYC federal tax lien notices) where a BUSINESS is the debtor. `name`: the debtor
        business name as registered (e.g. 'Publix Super Markets, Inc.'). `where`: 'all' (default), 'FL' (Florida Secured
        Transaction Registry, statewide), 'NYC' (ACRIS personal property records: fixture and co-op filings and federal tax
        liens, four boroughs), 'CO' or 'CT' (state open data). Returns each filing's number, type, filing date, lapse date,
        status, secured parties and, in NYC, the property. New York State (DOS), Texas, Illinois, Ohio, Arizona and
        Pennsylvania are not searched automatically; `not_automated` gives each official search link and why. Refuses a
        person's name.
name: ucc_lien_search
